title.text:
T10 one real day: P(|move| >= 50 bps within 60 minutes), 2025-11-15
Chosen by rule, before looking at it: among the 314 Look 2 UTC days with 24 hourly anchors, the day whose hit count (8 of 24) is the median (lower median, earliest on ties). Each shaded box starts at an anchor (the close of the
hour's last minute), spans 60 minutes and +-50 bps around that close; the number above it is H3's P(hit); orange boxes were hit. Data: Binance BTCUSDT forward file (a different venue from the Bitstamp history).
